description: Turn company names into the Lever site names that address their job boards, and report every instance that answered. search_jobs resolves names on its own, so reach for this to check which of several companies are on Lever at all: it probes names without reading a single board, where a search would read one per company.

names.description: A list of a company name, or a Lever site name you already know, one to 25 of them.

items.description: A company name, or a Lever site name you already know.

name: resolve_company

cached.description: True when this session had already resolved the name, so nothing was sent.

publishes.description: False when the site exists and publishes nothing.

tried.description: The forms sent, in order, one entry per request.

title: Resolve company names to Lever boards
